package.description: Control Panel for Z/Z2, Tracer and Creator mouse

en-US.description: Control Panel for Z/Z2, Tracer and Creator mouse
en-US.longDescription: The Swiftpoint X1 Control Panel allows users to configure and customize Swiftpoint Z, Z2, Tracer, and Creator mice. Features include button remapping, DPI adjustment, macro creation, and firmware updates. This package installs the official 32-bit Windows control panel version 3.0.8.0.
en-US.name: Swiftpoint X1 Control Panel
